name: § 160, point xvi – 41
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: (xvi) ensure that climate and environmental considerations are rationalised and reduced in the next MFF, while enhancing innovation, the development of modern technologies, and the competitive position of European producers;
